topic: Redesign root recovery and wound-message feel
currentUserGoal: Keep iterating the clean-break redesign after the first wound smoke by making manual root touches feel more like game interactions and reducing post-triage wound-message noise.
changesMade: Added scene-level recovery state to each RedesignPrototypeScene root node: recoveringUntil and lastTouchAt.
Normal roots now enter a short recovery after valid touches. Immediate repeat clicks on a recovering normal root give feedback and do not award HP, Run Touches, or objective progress.
Wounded roots remain immediately touchable so triage can override recovery timing.
Added stronger touch feedback: impact rings, stronger grass pulse/squash, tint/alpha recovery visuals, recovery-reject shake, and missed-root shake.
Extended browser debug root payload with recovering flags for smoke verification.

Tuned post-triage wound messaging: after the stabilizeWound objective, new wounds are treated as ongoing pressure, Sensi copy stays shorter, bottom prompt supports the dormancy objective, and feed entries are throttled to pressure milestones.
Updated docs/CORE_MECHANICS_REDESIGN.md and docs/CORE_MECHANICS_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md with root recovery and calmer post-triage wound messaging notes.
verification: npm run check passed after the recovery/messaging slice: ESLint passed, Vitest passed with 2 files and 19 tests, TypeScript compiled, and Vite built successfully.
Browser smoke on http://127.0.0.1:5173/?redesign&resetMemory confirmed the first valid root click wakes the run, expands to 2x2, and marks the touched root recovering.
Browser smoke immediately clicked the same recovering normal root and confirmed totalRunTouchesEarned stayed unchanged at 4.
Browser smoke waited for recovery, clicked the same root again, and confirmed totalRunTouchesEarned increased from 4 to 5.
Browser smoke replayed the first-wound path under recovery timing and confirmed activeObjectiveId advanced to completeDormancy with activeRootCount 25 / activeGridSize 5.
Browser visual smoke waited for post-triage wounds and confirmed the UI now uses Pressure remains copy while keeping the Reach Dormancy objective active.
Browser warn/error logs were empty during recovery and post-triage smoke checks.

knownIssues: Root recovery currently lives in RedesignPrototypeScene only. If recovery becomes core balance, move the rule into a pure new-canon system with unit tests.
The touch animation is improved but still prototype-level; recovery could use clearer ready-state art or a tiny progress glint.
Post-triage wounds are calmer, but the pressure cadence still needs playtesting once dormancy pacing is tuned.
The prototype still needs a more authored Sensi intro sequence; current intro copy lives in the HUD/side panel rather than a deliberate dialogue beat.
The player portrait is still a placeholder Grass Toucher icon, not a custom player avatar.
The old game still exists on the default route and in obsolete systems; do not use ?stress as evidence of redesign progress.
nextRecommendedSteps: Tune dormancy pacing now that the manual touch loop has recovery; fastDormancy can help verify the summary and next-run loop.
Move recovery into a pure system if it starts driving balance rather than presentation.
Add a small authored Sensi dialogue layer before or around the first tile touch.
Replace the player PFP placeholder with a new-canon player avatar while keeping Sensi as advisor/NPC.
Start recasting the first in-run tool or automation only after the run/dormancy loop feels readable end to end.

Do not return redesign manual healing to broad canvas/proximity clicks.
Do not remove the intro pause and return to immediate Scourge drain on fresh runs.
Do not replace the new objective-driven first-run flow with the old quest system.
Do not return the redesign prototype to a full 5x5 field at run start.
Do not commit unrelated local docs or media unless the user specifically asks.
